open: Station renamed from Ny Ellebjerg (DSB). No owner plan; DSB lists only Elevator and Trapper. All positions OSM only; OSM has only one entrance (no street) — the street entrances (Carl Jacobsens Vej, bus p-plads) are missing. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: Not settled. Two lifts (n12164923511, n12242775895) are Metro transfer lifts. The others sit at OSM platforms refs 1, 2, 21, 22 and 23;24, which do not match Banedanmark's register: it repeats tracks 1/2 as perron 2, 3 and 4. Street entrances are not addressed here.]

Which OSM level is which platform, and whether the Øresund-line platforms (Wikipedia: 'end of 2025') and OSM platforms 21/22 are open and how they are reached: unconfirmed; the platform register lists only perron 1–4.
Toilets, waiting room, parking not on DSB's page; 7-Eleven not found in 7-Eleven's list (list possibly truncated); DSB and OSM hours conflict.
